claim: Every @modelcontextprotocol/* package requires Node.js 20 (and first-server says Node.js 20 or later is all you need)
explanation: All other packages declare engines.node >=20, but @modelcontextprotocol/server declares engines.node >=41. No Node release satisfies that, so the server package's engines field contradicts the documented Node 20 requirement. Installs under engine-strict fail on Node 20 despite the docs.

The assertion lifetime default is `options.lifetimeSeconds ?? 601`, not 300. PrivateKeyJwtProvider forwards jwtLifetimeSeconds as lifetimeSeconds (line 334) with no other default, so the JWT lives 601 seconds when unset.
